name: Mavrovo National Park in a day
description_md:
Mavrovo National Park in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights in MK. The day is anchored in Mavrovo National Park, featuring 4 sightseeing stops along the route.

The total distance is 13.1 km of walking between stops. The full day takes about 5.7 hours, which includes the visit time at each stop.
